items.title: {"error":{"code":402,"message":"Your prepayment credits are depleted.}}
items.body:
Everything in my project works fine, but when I call the Gemini API, I get this error:

{ "code": 402,
"message": "Your prepayment credits are depleted. Please go to AI Studio at https://ai.studio/projects to manage your project and billing. Learn more at https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/billing#prepay. ",
"status":"RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED"}

Note: I already have billing enabled for this project, and I also have an AI Pro active subscription and enough GCP monthly credits (Google Developer Program premium benefit - CREDIT_TYPE_MONTHLY) in my billing account.

According to the Billing doc link in the error, it says this:

  • "No credits" if the billing account is required to purchase credits but the Prepay payments account isn't set up, or the available credit balance is depleted.

Does anyone know how to fix this error in the Gemini API?

items.title: How to make Android app discoverable by AI agents using AppFunctions?
items.body:
I'm working on an Android App project where I want to make it discoverable by AI Agents using AppFunctions. I want to perform some actions without opening the app.

I have followed the steps given in the official Documentation of AppFunctions from Google. Currently they have provided a Sample Chat App but how can I make it trigger by Gemini, ChatGPT or Claude?
